text: The subject Arslan Ghani holds account PK**HABB****1319 which was opened on 3 March 2025. The subject is declared as a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month. During the activity window from 2 May 2026 to 11 May 2026 the account recorded 16 credits totalling PKR 960,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 847,000. All credits arrived as 16 interbank (IBFT) transfers from 13 distinct senders. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 11 May 2026, with the typology MULE-01 scoring 360 against a threshold of 300. The presence of 13 distinct inbound senders in a short period aligns with the many unrelated inbound senders indicator. Debits equal to 88% of credits and a median of 4.7 hours between the latest credit and each debit suggest that most inbound value leaves the account within hours. Credits were 48.0 times the declared monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month for a Student, which is inconsistent with the customer profile. Two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, indicating potential fraud concerns. Overall, the pattern of many senders, rapid outflow, and activity disproportionate to a Student’s declared income of PKR 20,000 per month is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 572,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. PKR 275,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. Screening on 29 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
